datasetSources: JDS Skill Traits.xlsx (136 clean candidate evaluations)

methodology.title: Evidence-based Career Pathway and Role Similarity Engine
methodology.roleRepresentation: Constructed from canonical catalog skills, empirical posting counts, and salary brackets.
methodology.similarityMethod: Cosine similarity of normalized skill vectors combined with target core requirement coverage ratio.
methodology.pathwayScoring: Normalized composite (0–100): 50% Skill Similarity, 25% Experience Compatibility, 25% Market Demand/Opportunity (renormalized to 65%/35% when target role is outside market dataset).
methodology.analyticalGuardrail: Data-driven career pathway based on skill overlap and market evidence; does NOT represent historical career transition tracking.
